comment: Dr. Hagemeister isn't a bad professor, but he overcomplicates lab. He's extremely strict on reports and notebook checks, grading things like bringing a pencil or the textbook with no exceptions. He even makes you redo entire experiments, sometimes due to his own errors. Overall, it felt unnecessarily demanding; it feels like a high-school class.

Dr. H isn't a horrible professor, but he's not great either. I did fine in his lab, but he wasn't very receptive to student questions or participation. He gets grumpy easily, and he tends to get angry if students ask questions or don't immediately understand content. His grading is fair, but the environment isn't very good.
